goal: Localize a valid query-edge training failure without hotfixing and replace only the mismatched routing/control plane.
root_cause_hypothesis: The supervised routing score was a proxy dot product while actual specialist contribution used a different independent tanh gate. Independent edge gates also lacked competition, so irrelevant edges could remain strongly active even when routing supervision was poor.
closed_pattern: proxy routing score plus independent per-edge tanh contribution gates
causal_change: preserve edge-conditioned cross-attention representation; replace only routing/control with one competitive distribution over all active directed edges plus explicit parent/no-op, and use that exact distribution to scale runtime residuals
initialization_method: zero initialize route-head final layer and source/target residual readouts; exact parent comes from zero residual proposals while route supervision remains live
transferable_lessons: Supervise the exact control variable used at runtime; proxy routing metrics can improve independently of actual expert contribution.
If only one specialist edge should matter, independent gates are a poor inductive bias; normalized competition expresses the decision directly.
An explicit no-op/shared-parent route turns preservation into a routing decision rather than only an indirect output-matching constraint.
Hold representation and data fixed when localizing a control-plane failure so the next result has causal meaning.
